2.why: knowledge - pine is a prolific wind-pollinated producer, so its grains over-represent the trees present; that is the standard bias a pollen text would name

3.why: knowledge - burrow aeration of anoxic marsh sediment is the canonical crab-plant facilitation mechanism

4.why: shape - A and D agree variety 1 is 12 at Site A while C says 40, so C is out; among the rest only A shows a rank reversal across sites

5.why: none - C and D use the wrong endpoints, leaving A and B differing only in one cell (34 vs 30) with nothing in the options to decide it

6.why: shape - Layer 3 = 212 is stated three times and Layer 1 = 96 contradicts D's 86, killing D; C's 62.5 percent cut-over-tooth rate is taphonomically implausible

7.why: knowledge - clonal suckering rather than seedling recruitment under heavy grazing is the standard mechanism for a persistent thicket

8.why: act - only A ties the new rim form to identifiable contact with the upstream village; B and D are chronology and spread, not transmission

11.why: none - A and B share the 23-minute retention figure and disagree on distance, so one is the key and one the flip; nothing visible decides which

12.why: direction - the proposal is a route, and only D supplies a directional gradient (older the farther upriver) tracing it

13.why: act - C is the only option that explains a post-dam divergence without discarding the reconstruction, which is what such a text is set up to rescue

14.why: none - B (distant material, local carving) is the commonest archaeological result, but A, C and D are all legal readings of the same evidence

17.why: none - with the study's claim withheld, each quotation illustrates a different journal limitation and any of the four could be the one named

18.why: act - D is the corrective 'less of X than of Y' summary; C asserts the opposite revision process and B and A are narrower claims

cross_item_rule: One rule fired repeatedly and it is the rhetorical-act rule, not a content rule: on every stem that asks for a whole-text claim or for the finding that would support a proposal, exactly one option performs the act the stem names while the others perform a different act (a supporting detail, a rival mechanism, a mere chronology, a reversal of the premise). It decided items 1, 8, 9, 10, 12, 13, 15, 17, 18, 20, 22 and 23 - 12 of 24 - and the pick did not require the passage. A second, weaker rule fired on 3, 7, 19 and 21: the key is the canonical mechanism in its field (burrow aeration, clonal suckering, learned avoidance of deceptive flowers, mid-elevation diversity peak), so the biology alone chooses. Item 2 is arguably a fifth. On the six quantitative items the act rule did NOT fire: 4, 5, 6, 11, 16 and 21 all run the same direction across options, exactly as the author claims, and only 21 fell to outside knowledge (the hump-shaped curve) rather than to arithmetic.
constraining_pairs: Within-item contradictions, which are what the quantitative set actually leaks: item 4, A says variety 1 is 12 galls at Site A and C says 40 - and D independently repeats 12, so C is eliminable without the figure. Item 6, B assigns the total 86 to Layer 4 while D assigns 86 to Layer 1 and gives Layer 1 no other total; B's 96 for Layer 1 plus the thrice-repeated 212 for Layer 3 makes D the odd one out. Item 16, B and C state the same two cells (5 m from 0.1 m, 5 m from 0.4 m) as 71/96 and 64/88, so one of the pair is false; meanwhile A and D agree that 28 percent remains at 20 m from 0.1 m, corroborating that cell. Item 5, A and B are identical except for the 1-month advantage (34 vs 30) and D asserts a third value (44) for the same cell - the conflict is visible but supplies no way to pick, which is the good case. Item 11, A and B share 'a median of 23 minutes longer than the barbet' and then disagree about distance (about as far vs more than three times as far). Across items: 21's A and C agree that the 400 m count is 31 against B's 44. Non-quantitative: 10's A (the negotiators noticed) and C (they overlooked it) cannot both hold, and 18's C (revised by paring away) and D (revision was adding, not cutting) are direct contraries.
